labels.title: Log Entry
labels.description: Time-ordered observation or record of events, actions, or decisions.

labels.title: Reflection
labels.description: Personal analysis, lessons learned, and insights derived from experience.

labels.title: Action Item
labels.description: A single actionable task that should move work forward.

labels.title: Action Step
labels.description: A granular step that supports completion of a broader action item.

labels.title: Project
labels.description: A coordinated collection of tasks with a clear outcome and end date.

labels.title: Milestone
labels.description: A checkpoint that marks significant progress within a project.

labels.title: Objective
labels.description: A qualitative statement describing a desired outcome or direction.

labels.title: Key Result
labels.description: A measurable result that signals progress toward an objective.

labels.title: Decision
labels.description: A recorded choice, rationale, and implications for future work.

labels.title: Risk
labels.description: A potential issue with likelihood and impact that could affect outcomes.

labels.title: Issue
labels.description: A current blocker or problem requiring remediation.

labels.title: Idea
labels.description: A raw concept or opportunity that may be refined into work.

labels.title: Knowledge Note
labels.description: Reusable reference material, concepts, or distilled learnings.

labels.title: Meeting Note
labels.description: Notes, attendees, and outcomes captured from a synchronous session.

labels.title: Research Source
labels.description: External citations, articles, or data that inform the work.

labels.title: Resource
labels.description: Supporting assets such as templates, files, or external tools.

labels.title: Habit
labels.description: A recurring routine that reinforces desired outcomes.

labels.title: Template
labels.description: Reusable structure for consistent capture across the system.

labels.title: Review
labels.description: Periodic evaluation of progress, quality, and next steps.

labels.title: Metric
labels.description: Quantitative measure tracked over time with units and observations.
